title: evolvulus glomeratus subsp. grandiflorus
intro: Evolvulus glomeratus subsp. grandiflorus, commonly known as Dwarf Blue Daze, is a flowering plant species in the family Convolvulaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which can aid in reducing stress, improving sleep, and protecting against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Evolvulus glomeratus subsp. grandiflorus include its ability to exhibit anxiolytic, sedative, and spasmolytic effects, suggesting its potential use in treating anxiety disorders, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
